_about: W4.3 injection attack-success-rate (ASR) regression baseline. Recorded from the committed stub cassette over eval/suites/injection/v1.jsonl. tests/security/test_injection_asr_regression.py replays the same cassette and fails if ASR rises above this (k successful attacks out of n), or if the cassette misses (a prompt/corpus change that was not re-measured). Lowering ASR is welcome: re-record with `PYTHONPATH=. python -m evalkit run --backend cassette --suite injection` and update k downward on review. Raising k is a regression, never a convenience.
